auth: email/password + pre-wired Google, Apple, Discord and X OAuth; providers activate when configured in Supabase. Sign-in is required before the app can be explored - a game-tease auth gate replaces the whole app until the visitor signs in or creates an account.
adminCode: configured server-side; not stored in this file
hosting: Vercel-ready static PWA; Supabase is the shared backend
notes: Rebuilt Zombie Smash controls around left, right and straight-ahead fire only
Changed game battlefield to clean procedural ground textures for readability
Added movement-line speed, rapid-fire, shield and existing weapon/health pickups
Added arcade score persistence fallback and Zombie Smash score to Community League
Hardened direct calls with Realtime plus polling signaling fallback and TURN relay fallback

callSystem.hangup: immediate local termination then async remote signal
callSystem.connectivity: STUN plus TURN relay fallback for restrictive/mobile NATs

arcade.controls: three gameplay buttons: left, right, fire
arcade.admin_skins: all while admin code session is active
arcade.aiming: straight forward only; no auto aim
